Use case: stylized-concept. Generate a high-resolution raster CONCEPT BOARD of HD world art for the Allods Java ME fantasy RPG. Reference images show original game artwork: preserve its low, grounded rustic fantasy, recognizable silhouettes and earthy green/brown/gray palette. Match the craftsmanship of the prior HD icon concepts, but do NOT put gold decorative UI borders or jewelry on the world. Hand-painted game art with clear edges and controlled brush textures, not pixel art, not photography, not photorealistic 3D renders, not cartoon mobile MMO. Lighting upper-left. Perspective matches original: ground is orthographic overhead with horizontal/vertical square grid; tall objects show roofs and front faces, no rotated diamond/isometric tile grid, no cinematic horizon. Design around original 16px logical cell, future proposed HD visual scale64px/cell, without changing logical footprints. This is a presentation concept, not a guaranteed seamless production tileset. No lettering, numbers, labels, UI, characters or watermark. Opaque dark neutral charcoal presentation background, separated square/rectangular study panels. Make EXACTLY 12 equally sized square TERRAIN TEXTURE PATCHES in a 4 columns x 3 rows rectangular board, preferably 2560x1920. Minimal dark gutters and absolutely no ornamental frame. Each patch is a flat overhead sample covering an implied 4x4 grid of logical cells, with NO actual grid lines or illustrative perspective. Dense but calm textures with no conspicuous focal object, suitable for repeating maps. Keep contrast below hero sprites.
ROW1 left to right: healthy olive/emerald grass; variation of same grass with a few tiny weeds and sparse ochre blades; bare packed tan earth; gray-brown pebbled dirt road.
ROW2: horizontal road/grass transition with road in bottom half; vertical road/grass transition with road in right half; right-angle grass/road junction with natural worn edges; deep cool blue lake water with fine small horizontal ripples.
ROW3: straight horizontal shore with green grass at top, narrow ochre sand strip and blue water below; convex grass/sand shore corner meeting water; weathered horizontal wooden bridge planks with simple iron nails; compact gray-brown stone/gravel ground.
All adjoining versions must use same visual grass, dirt and water. Natural ragged transitions like original, without decorative outlines. Water clearly blue, not swamp green. No floating islands, no thick tile bevels, no 3D blocks, no visible text.
